provenance.source: PR #5875 fix(eventsource): fix retry wrap bug, squash-merged 2026-09-25 as a464b753d
provenance.note: Clean control: clamps the EventSource reconnection delay to setTimeout's 2^31-1 limit before scheduling, because larger delays (including Infinity) make Node fire the timer after 1 ms and turn a long reconnection time into a reconnect storm. Eight lines of production code plus a named constant; both producers of the delay bound it from below (the node.reconnectionTime option is an unsigned long, the retry field must pass isASCIINumber before parseInt), so Math.min alone cannot leave a negative or NaN delay, and the tests cover the field, the Infinity case and the option. No later commit touches either file (git log a464b753d..02c4f8c6e -- lib/web/eventsource/eventsource.js test/eventsource/eventsource-reconnect.js is empty, and each file's last commit is a464b753d itself), so no fix and no revert can reach its lines.
